import os, sys, unittest, sqlite3
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_batch(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_insert_then_update_counts(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": "A"}]), {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        # Same name still counts as updated.
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": "A"}]), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": "Alice"}, {"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}]),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b.c", "Alice"), ("x@y", "X")])

    def test_trim_and_lowercase(self):
        c = fresh()
        import_contacts(c, [{"email": "  Bob@Example.COM ", "name": "  Bob Smith  "}])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("bob@example.com", "Bob Smith")])

    def test_invalid_rows_rejected_and_nothing_written(self):
        bad_batches = [
            ["not an object"],
            [{"email": "ok@x", "name": "ok"}, None],
            [{"email": "ok@x"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x", "name": "ok", "extra": 1}],
            [{"email": 1, "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x", "name": None}],
            [{"email": "noat", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "a@b@c", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "@b", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "a@", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "a b@c", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "a@b\tc", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "a@b", "name": "   "}],
            [{"email": "A@b", "name": "x"}, {"email": " a@B ", "name": "y"}],  # duplicate after normalization
        ]
        for batch in bad_batches:
            c = fresh()
            add_contact(c, "keep@x", "Keep")
            with self.subTest(batch=batch):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(c, batch)
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("keep@x", "Keep")])

    def test_validation_happens_before_writes(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "a@x", "Old")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@x", "name": "New"}, {"email": "new@x", "name": ""}])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@x", "Old")])

    def test_database_failure_mid_batch_rolls_back(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "a@x", "Old")
        add_contact(c, "b@x", "Old")
        c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'fail@x' "
                  "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        c.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(c, [
                {"email": "a@x", "name": "New"},
                {"email": "c@x", "name": "C"},
                {"email": "fail@x", "name": "F"},
            ])
        self.assertFalse(c.in_transaction)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@x", "Old"), ("b@x", "Old")])

    def test_missing_table_failure_leaves_connection_usable(self):
        c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@x", "name": "A"}])
        self.assertFalse(c.in_transaction)

    def test_existing_api_still_works(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b", "Alice")])


class HandleImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_summary(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "A@b", "name": "A"}]}), {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b", "A")])

    def test_malformed_envelopes_rejected(self):
        bad = [
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"rows": []},
            {"contacts": {"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}},
            {"contacts": [], "extra": 1},
        ]
        c = fresh()
        for payload in bad:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
